title: Skull Crusher
summary: A lying triceps extension with an EZ bar or dumbbells.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: EZ curl bar or barbell (Olympic bar); weight plates; flat bench.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for triceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Lie on a bench holding the weight over your shoulders.
Tilt your upper arms back slightly toward your head.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight behind your head or to your forehead.
Straighten your arms back to the start.

form_cues.cue: Keep upper arms angled slightly back
Bend the elbows to lower the bar behind your head
Lowering behind your head gives the long head more stretch.

mistakes.text: Letting the elbows flare wide apart.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where a missed rep can be set down, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Peak-contraction focus.
Swap sheet: Triceps long-head bias, Better isolation, More stable.
